description: This file is a PHP web page that displays QoS and CallP statistics for a network gateway, including logs and configuration controls, with embedded JavaScript for user interactions.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Handles toggling logging and clearing logs based on user actions, updating configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends configuration data to the server via AJAX and reloads the page upon success.
